tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus and the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: unselected chips, input fields, the track behind progress bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between detail rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and the soft tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, asset count and locations under a row. Kept as light as contrast allows (4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-soft in both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Hartafolio green: primary actions, selected states, the first chart series, links. As text, on the surfaces and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected chips, the decision banner and positive highlights.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button, selected chip, active tab dot).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold as text or icon: zakat, nisab and haul information, gold and silver holdings callouts. On the surfaces and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-fill
tokens.usage: Gold as a fill: the second chart series, the nisab progress bar.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold-fill (never white).

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Background of attention items and anything near a zakat threshold.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: An increase in value: "+7,7% sejak awal dicatat". Always shown with a + sign or an up arrow, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: A decrease in value: "−1,3%". Always with a − sign or a down arrow. On the surfaces and loss-soft.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind an error message or a failed price fetch.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Donut and bar series 1: the largest member or asset type.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5 (smallest share). Separate every donut segment with a 2px gap in surface-raised so neighbours never touch.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring with a 2px gap, on every interactive element (≥3:1 on all surfaces in both themes).

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Teks
groups.note: One family, Plus Jakarta Sans from Google Fonts. Every amount uses tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The family total at the top of Beranda. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Haul mulai otomatis saat nisab tercapai.
styles.usage: Running text, form values, list items.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in rows and cards, right-aligned, tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip and button text, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row, timestamps, chart axes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, gap inside a two-line row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between swatch and row text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between stacked cards' contents.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top of screen to the first block; around the hero total.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separation, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatches enlarged to tiles, small badges, icon toggles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the select and its menu.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the add button, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on surface. Dark theme relies on surface-raised alone.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: The open select menu and bottom sheets.
